episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: President Andre Curtis goes head-to-head with the CIA over the possession of a secret tape, forcing him to confront deep secrets of his own.

episodes.title: Triangle
episodes.summary: After a dead Loch Ness monster washes ashore, Curtis, Banks, and O'Doyle must investigate a secret monster prison deep in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.title: Ex
episodes.summary: Curtis gets an invite to his ex-wife's inauguration gala, while Banks and O'Doyle are forced to undergo a job evaluation at a fully-immersive offsite facility.

episodes.title: Purchase
episodes.summary: After discovering an addendum on the Louisiana Purchase receipt, Curtis and his team must race against old enemies and friends to maintain control of the Louisiana Purchase territory.

episodes.title: David
episodes.summary: After butting heads with his own Party under the threat of being replaced, Curtis decides to visit Camp David to undergo a true test of his Presidential prowess. Meanwhile, Banks navigates camp politics.

episodes.title: Hollow
episodes.summary: When America faces a national energy crisis from overconsumption, Curtis and his team must venture deep into Hollow Earth to find a solution before America is plunged into darkness.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: When Banks contracts malware, O'Doyle enters her computer brain to find a fix. Meanwhile, Curtis gives the ghost of President Lincoln a gift that empowers him to settle his unfinished business.

episodes.title: Knox
episodes.summary: A robbery at Fort Knox puts Curtis and the FBI on a manhunt for the culprit, forcing O'Doyle to confront figures from his past to get to the bottom of it.
